subject: reading

practiceTest.note: Shape of the real STAAR test, from the released forms: items, time limit in minutes, items per reporting category.

note: Descriptions are short paraphrases for students and parents, not the official text. Skills with no category are reported as literary or informational depending on the selection; each item carries its category from the answer key.

categories.name: Understanding and Analysis of Literary Texts
Understanding and Analysis of Informational Texts

skills.description: Use nearby words and sentences to work out what a word means
Use prefixes and suffixes (un-, re-, -less, -ful) to understand words
Know synonyms, antonyms, idioms and words that look alike but mean different things
Make, check and correct predictions while reading
Make inferences and back them up with details from the text
Find the key ideas that a text's details support
Put information together to understand something new
Use evidence from the text to support an answer
Explain how characters' relationships and changes affect what happens
Follow the plot: the problem, the most exciting part, and how it ends
Explain how the setting matters to the plot
Explain rhyme, rhythm, lines and stanzas in poems
Use the central idea, text features and organization of informational texts
Recognize an author's opinion, audience and reasons in persuasive texts
Explain why the author wrote the text and the message it gives
Explain how pictures, captions and other text features help the author
Explain how the author's word choice, imagery and figurative language work
